description: This file defines a 'modelPrinter' struct and associated methods for printing schema information in Kubernetes, including resource kind, version, description, fields, and handling references, arrays, maps, and primitives.

classes.name: modelPrinter
classes.description: A struct for printing schema details, including resource kind, version, description, and fields, with methods for visiting schema components.

methods.name: PrintKindAndVersion
methods.description: Prints the kind and version of the schema.

methods.name: PrintDescription
methods.description: Prints the description(s) of a schema, handling multiple descriptions.

methods.name: VisitArray
methods.description: Recurses into array subtype, collecting descriptions and setting type.

methods.name: VisitKind
methods.description: Prints full resource info including kind, version, description, and fields.

methods.name: VisitMap
methods.description: Recurses into map subtype, collecting descriptions and setting type.

methods.name: VisitPrimitive
methods.description: Prints primitive field type and description.

methods.name: VisitReference
methods.description: Recurses into referenced schema, collecting description.

methods.name: PrintModel
methods.description: Entry point to print schema description and details.
